purpose.summary: Exercise the actual bounded regtest daemon through the existing upstream ALP engine and router: complete lifecycle, process reopen and token-only negative diagnostics.
scope: Signed local review parent only, not assumed public main. Inherited stop/reopen timeout remains unresolved and blocks PR readiness.
Test-only export of four script templates built by the existing upstream ALP constructors, exact unique token-id binding and native zero-value wire serialization.
Actual-daemon GENESIS1000/MINT500/SEND1400+100/BURN100; exact input/output colors, spender ancestry, token metadata, UTXOs, history and native first-seen timestamps.
Real pending and confirmed process reopen, confirmation, invalidation and reconsideration with the unchanged upstream writer/router and source/epoch admission.
Mint without baton and truncated builder metadata are native accepted transactions with token diagnostics only; continued native mining and no index quarantine are mandatory.
Retain every inherited case, assertion, deadline, equality and cleanup predicate without substituting ALP success for the refused matrix.
exclusions: No production source, ALP implementation, consensus, validation, policy, activation, dependency, default, plugin or service-capability change.
No deadline increase, assertion relaxation, failed-root adoption, wipe, identity rewrite, native token authority or incoming evidence.
No private history, operator data, server access, deployment, cutover, release, desktop integration or automatic proof promotion.

commands: Build the independent compiled-out profile with all upstream/plugin/observer flags OFF; execute the existing native zero-subsidy mining and positive-stop smoke.
expected_results: Native mining and shutdown work without linking Rust/Chronik; no Chronik state or external peer connection is created.

commands: Build separate archival and plugin profiles with BUILD_CHRONIK_UPSTREAM_REGTEST=OFF; run unchanged exact native selections and dormant daemon controls. Keep the enabled daemon build independent.
expected_results: No Python plugin implementation is selected; setup refuses before plugin files or state are created. Linking upstream alone starts no daemon index or listener.

commands: Build the unchanged regtest profile, plugins/Qt/observer OFF. Run alp_service.py --repetitions3, exactly one native template process with4 assertions and9 fresh daemons. Retain regtest_service.py and every inherited matrix with unchanged60-second process deadlines.
expected_results: Full ALP lifecycle and negative diagnostics use the actual upstream token engine and HTTP router; native accepted bytes remain the sole authority. All owned processes and disposable roots are removed before exclusive report creation.

scenarios.command: Run alp_service.py --repetitions3 from the bound public build: four exact upstream-generated templates,9 real-daemon processes, pending/reopen/confirm/disconnect/reconsider/confirmed-reopen, then negative token diagnostics and native mining.
expected_results: Each synthetic cycle has exactly1400 remaining atoms, one surviving mint baton and100 intentionally burned atoms before negative controls. Native inputs, outputs and actual fees remain zero.
Every token input/output color, spender, token/LOKAD history, raw transaction and native first-seen timestamp matches before and after real process reopen and reorg.
Native accepted mint without baton is token-invalid; truncated ALP metadata is diagnosed by upstream. The node still mines, the index remains healthy, and plugins/WS/broadcast remain disabled.
failure_conditions: Missing/duplicate/malformed upstream template, wrong case/assertions, color/baton/burn/ancestry/history/time/raw-wire contradiction, source/build drift, unexpected acceptance capability, timeout, nonzero exit, overwrite or incomplete cleanup.

expected_results: Inherited observer coverage only; this scenario does not establish the upstream daemon's readiness.

Concurrent old-transaction reads are either canonical 200 or protobuf 503, never a fabricated or partial response. After file removal the old transaction is 503; a retained recent transaction remains 200 and the node continues at its accepted height.

scenarios.command: Existing observer profile only, retained by chronik-port-core.yml: Run feature_chronik_token_http.py: extend to height 290 in bounded batches, disconnect below the retained projection anchor, reconsider, verify mismatched restart leaves HTTP disabled, then explicitly full-reindex. Separately exercise upstream retained-anchor and source-generation contradictions; the fixture observer closes while native progress continues.
expected_results: Inherited observer coverage only; this scenario does not establish the upstream daemon's readiness.
Both known and unknown token/transaction IDs return protobuf 503 after observer closure, never stale 200 or misleading 404.

Node RPC and chain selection continue; reconsider does not reopen observation. A persistent-tip mismatch disables HTTP on restart and logs recovery=reindex. Explicit full reindex restores canonical token metadata and byte-identical confirmed transaction output.
failure_conditions: Any accepted response after irreversible closure, missing-ID 404 from a degraded view, HTTP serving from a mismatched restarted runtime, missing mismatch diagnostic, failed canonical reindex recovery, node-authority effect, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

limitations: Inherited stop/reopen60-second timeout remains unresolved and blocks PR readiness. Targeted ALP success does not replace the refused required matrix.
Only bounded unpruned local regtest. No general service availability, full-chain performance, operator DB migration, arbitrary plugin, power-loss durability or deployment claim.
Zero-value fixtures test token interpretation and native mechanics, not funded token economics or standard relay. Synthetic1000000-fixoshi priority is not an actual fee.
No production source or dependency delta. System/SDK/runner inputs remain unlocked; upstream dependency alerts remain open.
No incoming evidence or independent public reproduction; all local reports remain ineligible for automatic promotion.
counterevidence: Immutable0051 records a required ten-repetition retained-matrix refusal at stop/reopen repetition7 after six passes under the unchanged60-second limit. Eight later instrumented groups passed, but instrumentation is not qualifying evidence and cannot replace that refusal.

A new early diagnostic sample captured the main thread reopening upstream RocksDB and recovering a WAL, including a read syscall. The instrumented run later timed out while advancing through different cases. Sampling is intrusive and does not prove a deadlock, disk cause or the cause of every timeout.
A real native template export and synthetic oracle tests are prerequisites, not substitutes for actual daemon execution. A successful component-only ALP test is not daemon coverage.
The new cleanup self-test initially refused a noncanonical macOS temporary-path alias; its caller was corrected to resolve the owned test root, preserving the fail-closed cleanup predicate.
